data.narrative: The student successfully demonstrated how to transform dense, passive-voice corporate prose into a highly scannable, top-down technical document. They proved a strong understanding of how buried ledes and undefined jargon actively harm incident response and team velocity.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified multiple specific communication failures in the 'bad' document.
dimension_scores.evidence: Categorized 'a decision has been reached' as passive voice and 'Given these considerations...' as a buried lede.

dimension_scores.observation: Reduced word count by 30% while retaining 100% of facts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Replaced 'It is expected that this migration will result in...' with 'This will eliminate 15 unnecessary aggregation endpoints.'

dimension_scores.observation: Tailored the document for a new hire (Priya) by defining acronyms.
dimension_scores.evidence: Defined SRE as '(Site Reliability Engineering) team' and SDK as '(Software Development Kit)'.
The opening sentence states the decision immediately: 'The backend team is migrating our public-facing API from REST to GraphQL...'

dimension_scores.observation: Assigned clear owners and deadlines to next steps.
dimension_scores.evidence: Wrote 'The backend team will monitor query performance daily' instead of 'These risks will be monitored'.

data.recommendation: Apply this same top-down structure in the upcoming Design Documents (RFCs) module.

public_evidence.student_action: Rewrote a 350-word dense technical memo into a 240-word scannable document.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Removed passive voice and defined all acronyms (FE, SRE, SDK) inline.
public_evidence.proof: Opening sentence: 'The backend team is migrating our public-facing API from REST to GraphQL to eliminate redundant endpoints...'
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates the ability to write high-signal, low-noise documentation that respects the time of executives and engineers alike.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Placed the core decision in the very first sentence without 'throat-clearing' filler.

teaching_approaches.detail: Contrasted 'risks will be monitored' with 'The backend team will track...' to show accountability.

learning_style_signals: Demonstrates strong editing skills when given a 'bad' example to deconstruct.
